title: Shipyard configuration
description: Non-secret Shipyard configuration. Resolved by scripts/sy_config.py across three layers, lowest precedence first: ~/.shipyard/config.json, <repo>/.shipyard/config.json (committed), <repo>/.shipyard/config.local.json (gitignored). Secrets never belong here — the resolver refuses any credential-shaped key.

tracker.description: Which tracker adapter to use. Must name a directory under skills/tracker/.

root.description: Directory holding /sy:ship worktrees. Null means a sibling <repo>-worktrees/ beside the repo.

dir.description: Root for per-identifier ephemeral working directories. Null means ~/.claude/shipyard/scratch.

poll_timeout.description: Seconds before the CI poller gives up.

columns.description: Board column names for the five canonical statuses. All five are required; matching is case-insensitive.

tracker_config.description: Adapter-specific configuration. The resolver passes this through uninterpreted; the selected adapter declares its own required keys in its ADAPTER.md and config-map.json.

tiers.description: Named tiers mapped to concrete model aliases, so raising the frontier tier is one edit rather than thirteen.

agents.description: Per-agent bindings. `model` is either a tier name or a concrete model alias, resolved at dispatch. `effort` is policy the resolver clamps and validates; per-agent effort is NOT settable at dispatch time (see docs/configuration.md).

max_depth_agents.description: Cross-cutting cap on simultaneous depth-investigation subagents (sy:trace/sy:hunt/etc.) in flight per phase — ship, spec, spike, and sy:gate all read this same key.

max_active_tasks.description: Cap on /sy:spec-ready Tasks a roadmap keeps active under one Epic at once.

light_tier_max_files.description: File-count proxy for "small": the light process tier is allowed only when the plan's declared file set is at most this many files and no risk lenses are activated.

request_ci_reviewer.description: Whether GATE requests an automated code-review bot (e.g. Copilot) on the PR, in addition to sy:gate's own independent review.

merge_strategy.description: Strategy passed to `gh pr merge`. Only squash composes a subject/body from the PR description; merge and rebase have none to compose.

max_needs_decision.description: A ship phase exceeding this many needs-decision returns without reaching done escalates to /sy:spec as underspecified.

max_needs_trace.description: A ship phase exceeding this many needs-trace returns without reaching done escalates to /sy:spec as missing evidence, on its own separate count.

attach.description: Whether /sy:plan, /sy:spec, and (full-tier) /sy:ship render and attach the session transcript to the tracker. A debug/observability tool for measuring Shipyard itself, not something most users need on by default.

truncation_limits.description: Per-block character limits applied when scripts/session_usage.py renders a readable transcript.

extra_words.description: Org-specific credential-name fragments merged into the built-in secret-word list (scripts/secret_words.py) used by scripts/secret_guard.py and scripts/scrub_known_secrets.py. Each entry must be a single alphanumeric word (the matcher is word-based, not substring-based, so a multi-word entry like 'ID_RSA' would silently never match anything).
